title: Galla kis din se nahi mil raha?
caption:
Galle ka paisa aur khaata alag alag bol rahe hain? Aap kaise pakadte hain ki fark kis din aaya? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a sweet-shop owner who opens a day-by-day cash book and sees the day her counted cash stopped matching her book. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Sunita: Sunita is a woman in her early forties who runs a small sweet shop, wearing a maroon saree with her hair in a bun.
cast.Raju: Raju is a thin young helper of about twenty in a white apron and cap.

scenes.vo: सुनीता की मिठाई की दुकान रोज़ शाम तक भरी रहती थी।
scenes.sub: Sunita ki mithai ki dukaan roz shaam tak bhari rehti thi.
scenes.art: Sunita behind the glass counter of a small sweet shop full of trays of sweets, customers waiting, evening light.

scenes.vo: रात को गल्ला गिना, तो पैसे कम निकले।
scenes.sub: Raat ko galla gina, toh paise kam nikle.
scenes.art: Sunita counting notes from an open cash drawer at night with a puzzled face, shop half shuttered.

scenes.vo: कल भी कम थे। परसों भी।
scenes.sub: Kal bhi kam the. Parson bhi.
scenes.art: Sunita looking at three small paper slips laid on the counter, rubbing her forehead.

scenes.vo: पर गड़बड़ शुरू किस दिन हुई, यह पता नहीं था।
scenes.sub: Par gadbad shuru kis din hui, yeh pata nahi tha.
scenes.art: Sunita flipping through a thick ledger under a tube light, Raju sweeping the floor behind her.

scenes.vo: पूरा महीना पलटना पड़ता, और नींद भी जाती।
scenes.sub: Poora mahina palatna padta, aur neend bhi jaati.
scenes.art: Sunita yawning with the ledger open, a wall clock showing late night.

scenes.vo: अगली सुबह उसने स्कोर माय बिज़ में कैश बुक खोली।
scenes.sub: Agli subah usne ScoreMyBiz mein cash book kholi.
scenes.art: Sunita in the morning with a cup of tea, opening her phone at the counter, fresh trays of sweets around.

scenes.vo: हर दिन का हिसाब अलग दिखा: शुरू में कितना, आख़िर में कितना।
scenes.sub: Har din ka hisaab alag dikha: shuru mein kitna, aakhir mein kitna.

scenes.vo: और जिस दिन गिनती खाते से अलग थी, वह भी।
scenes.sub: Aur jis din ginti khaate se alag thi, woh bhi.

scenes.vo: फ़र्क़ मंगलवार से शुरू हुआ था।
scenes.sub: Fark mangalvaar se shuru hua tha.
scenes.art: Sunita pointing at her phone with a look of discovery, eyebrows raised.

scenes.vo: उस दिन एक उधार की बिक्री लिखना रह गया था।
scenes.sub: Us din ek udhaar ki bikri likhna reh gaya tha.
scenes.art: Sunita talking kindly to Raju, who holds a box of sweets and looks apologetic.

scenes.vo: अब वह रोज़ रात को दो मिनट में मिला लेती है।
scenes.sub: Ab woh roz raat ko do minute mein mila leti hai.
scenes.art: Sunita closing the cash drawer with a calm smile, phone in her other hand, shop lights warm.

scenes.vo: आपका गल्ला आज खाते से मिला था?
scenes.sub: Aapka galla aaj khaate se mila tha?
scenes.art: Close-up of Sunita smiling at the viewer, trays of sweets softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
